visual.title: Level bands mean independence
visual.caption: When the two bands are the same height, conditioning on B does not change the chance of A. The right square is the B column stretched to full width, and it looks exactly like the conditional band.

predict.question: The two conditional probabilities are equal. What follows?
predict.explain: P(A|B) = P(A|Bᶜ) means conditioning on B leaves P(A) unchanged. That is the definition of independence, and it gives P(A ∩ B) = P(A)P(B).
